le-audio-resources.description: External Bluetooth/LC3 reference library. Start with README.md; ASSESSMENT.md covers independent codec tests, AUDIO-TESTING-RESEARCH.md covers test boundaries, FLPR-OFFLOAD-RESEARCH.md covers offload measurement, and agent-reference/ contains searchable extracts. Treat vendor materials as read-only; older reports are versioned research snapshots, not current acceptance.

nix-nrf-dev.description: Local Nordic tooling implementation and docs. Consult for current nix-nrf probes, identity, flashing and debug helper contracts; inspect read-only unless changes are explicitly requested.

ncs.description: Active receiver SDK: nRF Connect SDK v3.4.1. Authoritative installed source for APIs, Kconfig, devicetree, ISO/ACL time-sync samples and controller contracts. Overrides older global SDK reference; do not modify SDK source or mix versions.
